project_type: Next.js 16 App Router + TypeScript frontend that renders Drupal JSON:API data, with Server Components for page/service data loading, Client Components for interactive tabs/carousels, and CSS Modules for faculty-specific styling.
language: TypeScript/TSX and CSS Modules; Spanish UI copy.
build_system: npm scripts in package.json; Next.js 16.3.4 with next.config.ts output='export', trailingSlash=true, unoptimized next/image, and MDX support. TypeScript uses strict mode, bundler module resolution, and @/* mapped to the frontend root.
test_framework: No frontend test runner or application test files are configured. Verification uses the existing ESLint and Next.js build scripts.
verification_instructions: From /Users/Daniel/job-pagina-web/web_institucional_frontend, run npm run lint, then npm run build. The lint command must complete without ESLint errors and the build must complete successfully with all seven shared faculty routes compiling. If Drupal is unavailable, verify the service fallback/error state through the build output and avoid adding temporary logs; do not introduce a new test framework.
snapshot_or_generated_files: .next/ is generated by lint/build and is not a source artifact to edit or commit. No checked-in snapshots or generated source files are used by this task.
environment_constraints: Work directly in /Users/Daniel/job-pagina-web/web_institucional_frontend without creating a worktree. Drupal base URLs and image hosts come from environment variables consumed by services/api.ts and next.config.ts. The service cache options already use no-store in development and revalidate: 3600 in production; preserve them. Do not hardcode Drupal UUIDs or add persistent debugging logs.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md requires reading the relevant Next.js guide under node_modules/next/dist/docs before code changes; the server/client-components and caching-without-cache-components guides apply. Keep server-only Drupal access in services, pass only serializable props into FacultyAcademicOffer, and keep scope limited to individual pages below app/facultades plus the explicitly requested breadcrumb variant. Do not alter default or onDark breadcrumb output, the global header, NewsSection, or the global catalog behavior.
key_patterns: Services import server-only, use createDrupalClient/fetchJson, and define environment-sensitive OPCIONES_CACHE. oferta-academica.ts normalizes Drupal resources, follows JSON:API pagination through obtenerColeccion, and cargarOfertaAcademica returns ResultadoOfertaAcademica with noDisponible. FacultyPage is an async Server Component that serializes plain program data into the use-client FacultyAcademicOffer. FacultyAcademicOffer uses useState for ARIA tabs, next/image with fill/fallbacks, CSS Modules, a clickable anchor only when paginaProgramaUrl exists, and hover/focus/reduced-motion rules. Breadcrumbs is a use-client component that derives labels from usePathname and currently has default/onDark branches. Montserrat is available as --font-montserrat and brand colors are --institutional-red/#8c1919 and --institutional-gold/#fdb400.
directory_structure: app/facultades/page.tsx is the faculty listing; app/facultades/<slug>/page.tsx files for the seven individual faculties delegate to app/facultades/components/FacultyPage.tsx. The shared interactive offer is FacultyAcademicOffer.tsx with faculty-academic-offer.module.css. Faculty hero/layout styling is in faculty-page.module.css. Drupal access is in services/, data types and level normalization are in lib/, and shared breadcrumbs/news UI is under components/common/.
design_decisions: Use a dedicated server loader for faculty-filtered programs, parameterizing the existing program collection query and retaining the existing full-catalog loader unchanged. Start faculty and news requests together, then query the filtered offer only after the faculty title is known; if Drupal rejects or returns no exact relationship match, fall back to the existing full program collection and slug-filter in memory. Keep the page server-rendered and keep tab state/cards in the existing client component. Add one pure faculty-title segmentation helper rather than duplicating JSX for faculty routes, and add only a faculty breadcrumb variant so other breadcrumb consumers retain their current markup/classes.
